head: 5e8a015e106d62f088d906a3aab4c0ebcbb0024c
scope: Static review of new instance bindings, ownership, placement, accounting, public CLI and qualification harness; development checks only, not frozen qualification.

findings.detail: Inherited continuation/path helpers label support changes finite_deviation; continuation state also does not include dtype differences. New wrapper independently walks comparisons and emits support_failed, metadata_failed, structural_failed for dtype, nonfinite, and unchanged finite tolerance results. Unknown terminal states now reject.

A fixed nine-position whole/chunk witness alone cannot establish eviction for arbitrary supplied clocks. New independent CacheMetadataDiagnostic runs actual B1 prefill4/chunk2/decode5, requires observed positive-write eviction when the configured window is reachable, and explicitly marks larger windows uncovered. Default compact graph period6/window16 has 3 KV slots.

Separate arithmetic witness now performs full VJP, records None versus zero/nonzero parameter gradients, requires nonzero input and non-FFN memory gradients, checks nonfinite forward/gradient fields and actual BF16 matrix output.

HeadQuery fused path replays per-head mathematical accounting through _matrix; newly added dispatch counts could therefore claim many physical GEMMs for one concatenated fused base contraction. Requested separation of mathematical MAdd counts from physical dispatch, and clear treatment of fused Reception.

core_review: No additional core-binding defect found by static review. Narrow Q/K/V all use width/32 heads at fixed head width32; content/summary and original FFN ownership preserved. SSD vectors/convolution use declared memory owner groups. State remains node private. Checkpoint rebuilds ModelConfig and real optimizer state; replay exact-forward and tolerant actual-update claims remain separate.

development_checks.result: all within_threshold; FP32 four cases each have1536 nonzero input-gradient elements and nonzero memory gradients; BF16 observes genuine BF16 matrices and nonzero gradients
passed for reviewed existing core/statistics/CLI files

limits: No NPU or durable formal job launched by reviewer.
Short pre-review kv_sixth record retains FP32 whole/chunk readout max_abs7.09e-6 scaled1.215; CPU FP64 diagnosis within threshold does not establish cause.
